text:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert: autoscaler failing to provision GPUs in gcp-us-west4 — requests piling in queue. Observed increased 429s from serving, autoscaler logs show quota errors. Paging oncall @Dana. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/gpu-quota

Dana (oncall): Got it. Looking at autoscaler logs now. What was the exact error?

Pranav (sre): From the autoscaler controller logs:
```
ERROR autoscaler: failed to create instance: quotaExceeded: Insufficient regional GPU quota for project project-redwood-prod in us-west4: requested 16, available 0
```
Queue growth telemetry: pending requests +480% in last 10m, avg wait latency -> 12s, 95th -> 48s.

Jen (infra): Confirming quota hit at project level. I just queried GCP quotas:
```
gcloud compute regions describe us-west4 --project=project-redwood-prod --format=json | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric=="GPUS")'
{
  "metric": "GPUS",
  "limit": 24,
  "usage": 24
}
```
So we are at the hard limit (24). Autoscaler requests additional 16 GPUs and GCP rejects.

Mike O (ops): Any active maintenance or capacity reservations that could be freed quick? Can we kill any non-prod pools?

Jen (infra): Non-prod pools are already at 0 in that region. We do have a Dedicated pool for a backlog customer that could release 4 GPUs if we rotate them, but that needs approval (contract).

Alex (support): Customer impact: 3 customers onboarded in that region are seeing degraded throughput. Ticket queue shows increased latency complaints for customer "AtlasAI" (prod) and "DocuFlow" (some jobs delayed). Not yet full outage but rate-limited/failures for highest requests.

Anna (cust-eng): I'm on the call with AtlasAI. They're seeing timeouts on sync jobs. They need an ETA or a fallback we can enable.

Dana (oncall): Immediate mitigations we can do now: 1) Route some traffic to us-west2/us-central1 where quota is available; 2) Enable model fallback to smaller quantized variant to lower GPU unit requests; 3) Start quota increase request with GCP but that is slow. I'll start 1 and 2.

Pranav (sre): Executing traffic reroute play: updating service route table to prefer us-west2 (warm instances present). Command:
```
# update traffic policy
redwoodctl route update --service=gen-accelerator --prefer=us-west2 --dry-run=false
```
Watch logs for cache-warmups. This will add cross-region latency for some customers (~30-60ms extra).

Jen (infra): Starting GCP quota increase ticket (internal ref QINC-9876) with support case: "GPUs required to restore autoscaling in us-west4". Submitted with request: +32 GPUs, note: urgent, SEV2. ETA unknown. Case: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/9876

Mike O (ops): I can throttle lower-priority traffic to free headroom while we reroute. Setting rate limit rules for background batch jobs.

Dana (oncall): Implementing fallback config: enable model=redwood-medium-quantized for customers on us-west4, flag will lower instance GPU count per request. Pushing config:
```
curl -X POST https://config.redwood/api/v1/flags -d '{"flag":"region/us-west4/fallback_model","value":"redwood-medium-quantized"}'
```
Monitor: metrics queue_length and token_throughput.

Pranav (sre): After reroute/fallback: pending queue dropped 65% in 7m, 429s stopped for most users; a handful still hit because they were pinned to us-west4 by sticky session.

Anna (cust-eng): AtlasAI confirmed some requests succeeded after fallback, but they reported degraded quality in ~10% of calls. They're asking for prioritized remediation.

Alex (support): Logging customer-facing status update draft: "We're investigating elevated latencies in us-west4 due to regional GPU quota limits. Traffic is being routed to nearby regions and temporary model fallbacks are active. No data loss. Working on quota increase and longer-term capacity solutions." Ready to post once SRE Lead approves. :loudspeaker:

SRE Lead: Good triage. Next actions:
- Keep reroute+fallback in effect until quota increased or capacity freed.
- Infra to identify any non-customer-critical reserved capacity that can be reclaimed with manual contract check (Jen).
- Ops to maintain throttles on batch jobs.
- Support to post status and list impacted customers.
- Prepare runbook postmortem: why autoscaler didn't gracefully degrade/route earlier.

Jen (infra): Noted. Also will check if quota is blocked by a long-running reservation in that project. If so, we can move some reservations to another region (requires 30m).

Dana (oncall): Handoff: I've stabilized now. Handoff to Pranav for monitoring and escalation. Pranav please ack and take next shift at +2h.

Pranav (sre): Acknowledged. I'll keep patrol for 2 hours, confirm GCP case progress, and coordinate with Jen for any manual capacity moves.

incident-bot: Reminder: create incident ticket IR-2026-1961234567 and attach timeline.

SRE Lead: Summary for IR: cause = regional GPU quota reached in gcp-us-west4 causing autoscaler fail-to-provision; impact = elevated latencies/429s for customers pinned to region, partial mitigation = cross-region routing + fallback model + throttles; permanent fix path = quota increase or rearchitect to avoid single-region hard quota dependency.

Alex (support): Publishing status update now.

Anna (cust-eng): I'll follow up with AtlasAI and DocuFlow with ETA and remediation notes.

Pranav (sre): Monitoring graphs show traffic mostly steady on us-west2, no further 429s. Leaving fallback flags enabled for 3h and will re-evaluate. If GCP quota increase completes earlier, we'll roll back.

Dana (oncall): Thanks everyone. If anything changes ping with @channel. Closing handoff. :white_check_mark:
